sample.test: error_user logs out from the menu and returns to the login page

observations.note: saucedemo ships the Backtrace SDK with its placeholder credentials never replaced: the bundle configures url: https://submit.backtrace.io/UNIVERSE/TOKEN/json, where UNIVERSE and TOKEN are literal strings. Backtrace rejects that with 401, and a 401 response carries no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so the browser also logs a CORS error about the very same rejected response - which is why two detectors report one cause. Not a defect worth chasing: real credentials in a public bundle would be worse. Verified 2026-09-07 by reading /assets/index-XyuNVFOR.js.
